# 453. Minimum Moves to Equal Array Elements

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def minMoves(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        min_nums = min(nums)
        ans = 0
        for num in nums:
            ans += (num - min_nums)
        return ans
```
